{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5","id":"msg_011CenY1B3g4ZvzQzH9H7aMg","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01AKMps7vUv9QsF7qCJMUL9L","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/llmtest/evals/20260901-162328/floydwarshall_claude-sonnet-5-cc-medium_hybrid_r3/floydwarshall/floydwarshall.cpp","content":"#include <mpi.h>\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nconstexpr unsigned int INF = 1000000000;\nconstexpr unsigned int MAX_DISTANCE = 200;\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                          \\\n    do {                                                                          \\\n        cudaError_t cudaCheckErr_ = (call);                                       \\\n        if (cudaCheckErr_ != cudaSuccess) {                                       \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error at %s:%d: %s\\n\", __FILE__, __LINE__,      \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(cudaCheckErr_));                           \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                         \\\n        }                                                                         \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// Row-block distribution of the global N x N matrix (row-major, row i occupies\n// the contiguous range [i*n, (i+1)*n) ) across MPI ranks. Rows are split as\n// evenly as possible, with the first `remainder` ranks getting one extra row.\nstruct RowRange {\n    size_t start;\n    size_t count;\n};\n\nRowRange rowRangeForRank(const size_t numNodes, const int rank, const int numRanks) {\n    const size_t base = numNodes / static_cast<size_t>(numRanks);\n    const size_t rem = numNodes % static_cast<size_t>(numRanks);\n    const size_t bigBlockRows = rem * (base + 1);\n\n    if (static_cast<size_t>(rank) < rem) {\n        const size_t count = base + 1;\n        return {static_cast<size_t>(rank) * count, count};\n    }\n    return {bigBlockRows + (static_cast<size_t>(rank) - rem) * base, base};\n}\n\nint ownerOfRow(const size_t k, const size_t numNodes, const int numRanks) {\n    const size_t base = numNodes / static_cast<size_t>(numRanks);\n    const size_t rem = numNodes % static_cast<size_t>(numRanks);\n    const size_t bigBlockRows = rem * (base + 1);\n\n    if (k < bigBlockRows) {\n        return static_cast<int>(k / (base + 1));\n    }\n    return static_cast<int>(rem + (k - bigBlockRows) / base);\n}\n\n// Generates this rank's row-block of the distance matrix so that the values\n// are bit-for-bit identical to the values the original sequential\n// rand_r()-based generator would have produced at the same flat indices.\nvoid initializeDistanceMatrixLocal(std::vector<unsigned int>& localDist, const size_t numNodes,\n                                    const size_t rowStart, const size_t localRows,\n                                    const unsigned int rangeMin, const unsigned int rangeMax) {\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    const double range = static_cast<double>(rangeMax - rangeMin) + 1.0;\n\n    const size_t skip = rowStart * numNodes;\n    for (size_t p = 0; p < skip; ++p) {\n        rand_r(&seed);\n    }\n\n    const size_t total = localRows * numNodes;\n    for (size_t p = 0; p < total; ++p) {\n        localDist[p] = rangeMin + (unsigned int)(range * rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX);\n    }\n\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < localRows; ++r) {\n        const size_t globalRow = rowStart + r;\n        localDist[r * numNodes + globalRow] = 0;\n    }\n}\n\nvoid initializePathMatrixLocal(std::vector<unsigned int>& localPath, const size_t numNodes,\n                                const size_t rowStart, const size_t localRows) {\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t r = 0; INF = 1000000000;\nconstexpr unsigned int MAX_DISTANCE = 200;\n\n// Index calculation for flattened 2D array\ninline constexpr size_t idx2(const size_t i, const size_t j, const size_t n) noexcept {\n rangeMax) {\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    const double range = static_cast<double>(rangeMax - rangeMin) + 1.0;\n    \n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes * numNodes; ++i) {\n        dist[i] = rangeMin + (unsigned int)(range * rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX);\n    }\n    \n    // Set diagonal to zero (distance from node to itself is 0)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n floydWarshall(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, \n                   std::vector<unsigned int>& path, \n                   const size_t numNodes) {\n    // Classic Floyd-Warshall algorithm\n    // For each intermediate node k\n    for (size_t k = 0; k < numNodes; ++k) {\n        // For each source node i\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n            // For each destination node j\n {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5","id":"msg_011CenYKYnspaFWQjonTkhaW","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Only the original two files remain, no new files created, executable name unchanged (`floydwarshall`).\n\n## Summary\n\nI parallelized `floydwarshall.cpp` with a hybrid **MPI + OpenMP + CUDA** approach:\n\n- **MPI**: the N×N distance/path matrices are row-block distributed across ranks. Each Floyd-Warshall iteration `k` broadcasts the owning rank's row `k` to all ranks (`MPI_Bcast`), so memory and compute scale across nodes/GPUs.\n- **CUDA**: each rank offloads its local row-block update to a GPU kernel (`fwUpdateKernel`), one rank mapped to one local GPU (auto-detected via local-rank env vars, falling back to `rank % deviceCount`).\n- **OpenMP**: used for host-side parallel work — local path-matrix initialization and the validation routine's triangle-inequality check.\n- Initialization was rewritten to generate only each rank's row-block while fast-forwarding the same `rand_r` sequence as the original, so results are **bit-identical** to the sequential baseline (verified below).\n\n`CMakeLists.txt` now builds the single source file as CUDA (`LANGUAGE CUDA`), and links MPI/OpenMP/CUDA runtime, with no new external dependencies.\n\n**Verification performed** (GPU: 3× RTX 3090):\n- Hashes match the original sequential implementation exactly across `-n 300` and `-n 13`, with 1–20 MPI ranks (including uneven splits and rank count > node count).\n- `-v` validation passes in all cases.\n- Scaling: 1→3 GPUs cuts `-n 4000` runtime from 567ms→342ms; vs. the original CPU code (68.9s), the single-GPU hybrid run is ~120× faster.\n\nBuild directory and comparison files used for testing have been removed; only `floydwarshall.cpp` and `CMakeLists.txt` were modified."}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":328,"cache_read_input_tokens":63176,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":328},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"f90159eb-c211-4b3d-989f-ab3f9b406eb2","uuid":"4f90ead6-e601-4420-8340-11bcbb75490c","timestamp":"2026-09-06T16:58:32.515Z","request_id":"req_011CenYKXvHW9ihgHR5E53oa"}
